assumptions: One primary contributor, approximately five engineering days per working week, with bounded independent assistance and one integration owner.
Estimates include review and relevant validation but not unpredictable external provisioning, upstream breakage, major migration surprises, or lengthy interruptions.
The first supported runtime, OMP version, package manager, platform, and application validation commands are verified in M0.
A local-first lightweight architecture is preferred; no mandatory dependency on LangChain memory, SimpleMem, Cognee, or a graph database is implied.
M1 includes a real working LAN-accessible dashboard, text QR startup, private-data pairing, and durable Snooze rather than a static mockup.
Parallel agents do not remove shared-file, integration, or review constraints; the calendar envelope is not a delivery promise.
Re-estimate after M0 and M1 using actual throughput and measured workload costs; requested scope changes are recorded explicitly.

timeline.critical_path_note: The path includes required M7 native archive/integrity/restore, not an obligation to ship costly optional adapters. M3 is required before M4 and may become critical. Effort includes M3 and does not assume unlimited contributor capacity.

parallel_lanes.name: Core and OMP adapter
parallel_lanes.constraint: Separate worktrees; serialize schema/lockfile changes and integration.

parallel_lanes.name: Observatory views
parallel_lanes.constraint: Start each view only after its stable contracts and real data path; acceptance must use the runtime.

parallel_lanes.name: Attunement and Ebb
parallel_lanes.constraint: Can overlap M2 with sufficient capacity; reconcile identity/scoping before M4.

parallel_lanes.name: Native portability and optional MCP contract spike
parallel_lanes.constraint: Native contracts can start after M2; restore acceptance requires M6. MCP work starts only if selected and does not gate native portability.

parallel_lanes.name: Evaluation and documentation
parallel_lanes.constraint: Prepare checks with concrete behavior; never claim unimplemented runtime checks passed.

milestones.completion_policy: Complete required_task_ids; complete selected optional_task_ids and record scoped deferral decisions for unselected optional tasks. Required native portability is never optional.

optional_extensions.selection_policy: Create a bounded implementation task only if selected; native archive and integrity/restore remain mandatory.
Adopt only for measured benefit and acceptable cost; native portability must work without one.
